step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify nodes from the whiteboard:
   - Satellite icon on top left: External third-party satellite data source ('ThirdParty').
   - EC2 SPOT: Amazon EC2 spot instances ('EC2').
   - S3: Amazon S3 storage ('S3').
   - RDS: Amazon RDS database ('RDS').
   - ELASTICACHE: Amazon ElastiCache ('ElastiCache').
   - AWS FARGATE: AWS Fargate compute cluster ('Fargate').
   - LAMBDA: AWS Lambda functions ('Lambda').
   - User icon: End-user application / web consumers ('UserConsumerWeb').

2. Trace connections:
   - Data Ingestion: ThirdParty (Satellite) -> EC2 Spot -> S3 & RDS.
   - Web Tile Serving: UserConsumerWeb <-> AWS Fargate <-> ElastiCache. AWS Fargate queries RDS for metadata and retrieves data from S3.
   - Time Series Processing: UserConsumerWeb / Input -> Lambda. Lambda queries RDS and reads data from S3 to perform calculations.
